messages:
devin-customer: hitting errors on /v1/rerank when I send a lot of docs. getting a 4xx with a vague message 'request size limit exceeded' — can someone help?

anna-support: sorry about that — do you have the original request id or the raw payload you can paste (sanitized)? also which model/endpoint are you calling?

devin-customer: here's the sanitized payload we used (removed PII). endpoint: POST /v1/rerank, model: ranker-light-1. payload: ```json
{
  "query": "This is a pretty long query... (actually ~3.5k chars)",
  "documents": ["<doc1 is 12k chars>", "<doc2 11k chars>", "<doc3 12k chars>", "... ~420 docs total ..."]
}
```

devin-customer: response body: `{"error":"request size limit exceeded"}` and HTTP 400. no request-id in response.

anna-support: thanks — can you share the x-request-id from the response headers if present? also approx total payload bytes?

devin-customer: no x-request-id returned. payload ~5.1MB. curl header showed Content-Length: 5200000.

anna-support: copying in @mike-plat and @nina-eng to check limits and error messaging.

mike-plat: quick note — rerank has a few layered limits: per-document char limit (~20k chars), per-query token limit (~2048 tokens), and a hard request payload size cap at the edge (5MB). historically we return a generic 400 when edge rejects the request which is not super helpful.

nina-eng: I'm seeing a spike in 4xxs matching this client's pattern around 2025-11-09T02:... (log snippet). Edge responded 413/400 intermittently depending on proxy. Example log: ```
EDGE: POST /v1/rerank 413 Payload Too Large length=5201240 client=devin-corp
RUNTIME: validation failed: payload_size_bytes=5201240 > max_allowed_bytes=5242880? actually it's under 5MB? need to double-check conversion.
```

lee-sre: re-checking: 5MB == 5242880 bytes. If they have 5,200,000 that is slightly under; but if encoded and with headers maybe over. Also if we have internal pre-parsing temporary allocations it can surpass edge limit.

nina-eng: good point. But even if payload is accepted, we still run per-doc char and per-query token checks in the rerank service and those return different errors that we surface as a generic 400. we should improve message to include which limit was hit.

anna-support: short-term: can we reply to the customer with exact actionable guidance: max docs per request, per-doc char limit, recommended client-side checks, and sample curl showing chunking?

mike-plat: yes. make it: 1) Max docs per request: 1000 (but we recommend <= 500 for latency/quality) 2) Per-document characters: 20,000 chars 3) Query token limit: 2048 tokens (approx 1500–2000 chars depending on language) 4) Hard request payload cap: 5MB. advise using chunking and dedup.

anna-support: i'll send that to the customer along with repro steps to confirm which limit they hit. draft reply: "Looks like your payload is large and exceeds one of our rerank limits (per-request payload or per-doc size). Try trimming docs or sending fewer docs in each call. If you share one failing request we can test and tell you which limit was hit." any edits?

nina-eng: please also request the x-server-log-id if available. For repro i will run a local test with their sanitized payload.

devin-customer: sending one example doc and the query now in the thread (sanitized).

anna-support: got it — reproducing now. @nina-eng I'll paste the exact command I used: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  --data-binary '@payload.json' -D -
```

nina-eng: ran it, got back 422 with body: ```json
{
  "error": "RERANK_QUERY_TOO_LONG",
  "message": "query token length 4250 exceeds max 2048",
  "limit": "query_tokens",
  "limit_value": "2048",
  "current_value": "4250"
}
```

nina-eng: so in this case it's the query token limit, not overall payload size. the customer query is ~4k tokens because they pasted a very long narrative.

anna-support: perfect — I'll pass that along. recommend they shorten the query and keep long context inside docs instead of making the query long.

mike-plat: longer term we should: 1) standardize error shapes from edge through runtime (include error_code, human_message, limit_type, limit_value, current_value, request_id) 2) surface the exact limit in the error so support/devs and customers know what to change 3) add client-side SDK validation to surface early errors.

lee-sre: agree. also add improved logging so support can always return a server-side x-server-log-id in the response headers for any 4xx/5xx.

anna-support: i'll create a support doc and update FAQs with concrete examples and a small troubleshooting checklist: - check Content-Length - validate query length (tokens) - check per-doc char size - try splitting docs - attach x-server-log-id when contacting support

nina-eng: action items for eng: I'll open PR to change the error payloads in rerank runtime and edge to include structured limit info and request_id. I'll also add unit tests for long query detection and an integration test that ensures the edge doesn't swallow structured error fields.

mike-plat: plan for rollout: canary on dedicated for 48h, then gradual rollout to hosted API region us-west-1, update SDKs + docs simultaneously. Notify support slack channel before prod flip.

anna-support: customer notified with the specific error: "RERANK_QUERY_TOO_LONG — query tokens 4250 > 2048. Shorten the query or move content into documents. If you want we can help chunk the docs on your side." they replied :thumbsup: and will try.

inc-bot: new ticket created: #CUST-9876 assigned to anna-support (auto).

anna-support: closing loop for now. nina/mike — please link the PR/epic back here when you have it so we can update the support KB.

nina-eng: noted — will link PR: https://git.internal/redwood/rerank/+/PR-2345 and epic: RED-3123 once opened.

lee-sre: leaving a reminder to monitor error rate for RERANK_* limit errors post-rollout for 72h.

anna-support: thanks all, marking resolved with the customer. will reopen if they hit follow-ups.
